description: ChainDrop (Mini Shai-Hulud) npm worm detection data. Poisoned releases carry VALID GitHub-Actions/SLSA provenance, so `npm audit signatures` PASSES them — detection must be IOC-based. FAIL only on a version listed in `poisoned`; family presence at a pre-attack version is NOT an IOC (these are ubiquitous eslint transitive deps). See docs/supply-chain-defense.md.
note: Core-family table (incl. @keyv/* scoped packages) is the confirmed, cross-verified subset (Wiz CSV + OSV MAL- records + GitHub Advisory DB + live npm registry `time` map). The worm self-propagated to 443-1,381 versions across 400-868+ packages; the full downstream list is NOT bundled here — pull it at scan time. Full set: `npx osv-scanner --lockfile=package-lock.json` (cross-references OSV MAL- records), or the Wiz CSV `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiz-sec-public/wiz-research-iocs/main/reports/keyv-packages.csv`. This manifest bundles the core family so offline detection is precise without a network call.
publishWindowNote: Earliest poisoned publish: @keyv/test-suite@6.0.0 at 09:30:01Z (keyv@6.0.0 at 09:35:00Z). Heuristic: a compromised-family version published >= 2026-08-04T09:30:00Z is suspect. Registry `time` maps still retain poisoned entries as of 2026-08-05, but this is not guaranteed to persist — lockfile version match + on-disk artifact IOCs are the robust detections. Also scan the npm/bun cache, not just node_modules (versions were unpublished AFTER being installed).

fileMarkers.variantPattern: Math_*.js / math_*.js — the stage-2 harvester is also seen under generated names (Math_<guid>.js). The scanner WARNs on the pattern and escalates to FAIL when the file carries a known-bad hash or is payload-sized (>=200KB; the real stage-2 is ~727KB).

fileHashes.9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357b: Math_Symbol.js / math_init.js — stage-2 Bun-bundled harvester (727680 B)
fileHashes.54dc7ea54a1317cca0e890a2770630cf7fa6c978: setup.mjs — wave-1 loader (29918 B, always exits 0)
fileHashes.fd3ca4007b225fdf8de7af4345a19179d5efa8c4: setup.mjs — later-wave loader (11017 B, exits non-zero on error)

persistence.claudeSettings: .claude/settings.json — injected SessionStart hook executing the loader

remediationOrder: CRITICAL: ChainDrop plants a gh-token-monitor watcher that detonates a destructive payload when a stolen token is revoked. Remove the watcher (and its systemd unit / macOS LaunchAgent) BEFORE rotating any credentials.
